verdict.rationale: Homebrew's docs say a matching bottle (a prebuilt binary package) is downloaded and installed automatically on `brew install`, and source builds happen only when bottles don't apply or the user passes `--build-from-source`. Taps can also publish their own bottles, and casks install upstream prebuilt binaries. One community report notes that on Linux, prebuilt binaries require the /home/linuxbrew prefix, which limits use without root. Missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of bottle install behaviour and speed, and documentation of what happens when no matching bottle exists (source-build fallback and non-default prefix limits).
